Which class has the minimum number of students from all schools together?
solution:
**Given:**

The table shows number of students in different classes in different schools.

**Calculation:**

According to given table,

There are six schools such as P, Q, R, S, T, U and six classes such as V, VI, VII, VIII, IX, X.

The sum of number of students of all schools in different classes are given.

Total number of students of all schools in class V = 917

Total number of students of all schools in class VI = 924

Total number of students of all schools in class VII = 904

Total number of students of all schools in class VIII = 919

Total number of students of all schools in class IX = 903

Total number of students of all schools in class X = 910

Here, The total number of students of all schools is minimum in class IX i.e. 903.

**∴ Minimum number of students from all schools together is in Class IX.**
